about_the_game:
Mark of Cain: The Game
What gaming should have been instead of a chore.

Step into a blood-soaked, demon-infested fever dream of early 2000s chaos with Mark of Cain, the co-op movement FPS where speed is survival and memes are gospel. You and your squad are cursed with the legendary Mark of Cain—a glowing sigil that attracts unrelenting hordes of demons from the pits of hell and beyond. There’s no hiding. Only running, sliding, wall-jumping, and blasting your way to a temporary moment of peace before the next wave descends.

Mark of Cain is a love letter to the golden age of LAN parties and low-poly madness. The aesthetic? Crunchy textures. Grimy corridors. Lens flares that are way too bright. It’s the kind of game you'd find in a forgotten folder on a Windows XP desktop—and it's awesome.

Key Features:

  • Co-op Carnage – Team up with friends in seamless drop-in/drop-out multiplayer and face the infernal legions together. Trust is optional. Speed is mandatory.

  • Fluid Movement System – Wall-running, slide-jumping, bunny-hopping, air-dashing—you name it. Movement is king. Master it or get left behind.

  • The Mark Is Your Curse – The glowing sigil draws the worst things imaginable to your location. Your curse is your gameplay. You're not the hunter—you’re the hunted.

  • Old-School Aesthetic – From the jagged models to the over-the-top sound design, this game drips with early 2000s nostalgia. CRT filter optional, attitude required.

  • Weapon Skins with Style – Earn skins through gameplay, unlocks, and even by just hanging out in the right place at the right time. Some rare skins can also be traded or bought through a Steam Marketplace-style system. No loot boxes. No battle passes. Just vibes.

  • Achievement-Driven Gameplay – At the core of the game is one goal: complete them all. Achievements that unlock new rewards and bragging rights. Flex your 100% profile like it’s a badge of honor—you earned it.

  • Unhinged Humor – Packed with irreverent pop culture references, bizarre in-game moments, and an overall tone that doesn’t take itself too seriously. If you know, you know.

  • No Chores, Just Chaos – No daily quests. No time-gated content. Just fast, fluid gameplay built around movement, mayhem, and a touch of madness.

Whether you're speedrunning hell’s maze, trick-jumping across rooftops, or hunting down the last obscure achievement for the flex—Mark of Cain is here to bring the fun back to FPS.

Get cursed. Get chased. Get good. Then brag about it.

name: Mark of Cain

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3-7100 or AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 Ti or equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: Not supported
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 or AMD Ryzen 5 3600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1050 Ti or AMD RX 570
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 500 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • VR Support: Not supported

short_description: Mark of Cain is a fast-paced co-op FPS by a solo dev where cursed players outrun demons in a world of early 2000s chaos. Master movement, embrace the memes, and chase achievements. Get cursed. Get chased. Get good.
